name: Jump Higher Per RNG[Offline RNG]
desc:
🌀 Welcome to RNG JumpPower!

🎲 Roll the RNG, 💥 boost your Jump Power, and 🚀 reach INSANE heights!

Begin as a tiny jumper 🐣 and evolve into a sky god 🕊️✨ — only your luck can take you there.

💡 Upgrade your power, unlock rarities, and flex your height on the leaderboard! 💪📈

Are you lucky enough to reach the edge of space? 🌌⭐
